The key responsibility of this position is to use the scientific method to test novel applications of AI in mental healthcare.

You'll work with a small group of engineers, data folks, and clinicians at Sensible Care to discover new ways AI can help improve patient outcomes in mental health.

* 3+ years of hands-on, production-level software development experience

* A willingness to take initiative and ownership in a small-company environment

Google Quantum AI designs and fabricates its own superconducting quantum processors. Every step depends on software, and as our processors grow in scale and complexity, the speed and reliability of that software determine how quickly we can iterate.

In this role, you will be the dedicated software engineer owning our chip design infrastructure. Partnering closely with quantum processor designers in Santa Barbara, you will architect and maintain the software layers that power the design workflow.  
  
You will balance high-leverage workflow unblocking for designers with long-term infrastructure roadmap projects, letting hardware and physics experts focus on processor design.

The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations.
